subject: SIG questionnaire — annotated diffs & proposed re-answer timeline (CloudTrust)
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@cloudtrust.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: David Lopez <david.lopez@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG packet (revision 2026-10) — re-answers and diff summary

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for agreeing to help us with the expedited SIG for the ACME Retail assessment. Attached is the latest SIG packet issued by ACME's security team — this is the 2026-10 revision. We noticed several items in your previously submitted responses that will need re-answering to match the new schema and a small set of new questions around key rotation and multi-tenant isolation.

Can you provide:
- A consolidated re-answer file (spreadsheet) that follows the new question IDs (they added suffixes)
- An annotated diff identifying where current answers change (CSV or markup)
- Evidence pointers for any control that changed (S3 path or log excerpt)

Target timeline from ACME: initial re-answers within 72 hours, final evidence within 10 business days. If that isn't possible, let me know what is achievable and we'll escalate accordingly.

Attachments: CloudTrust_SIG_packet_2026-10-28.pdf

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Senior Assessor, CloudTrust Security
elena.ramos@cloudtrust.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@cloudtrust.com>, David Lopez <david.lopez@acme-retail.com>
Cc: karrthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG packet (revision 2026-10) — re-answers and diff summary

Elena / David,

Appreciate the heads up and the packet. We can meet the initial 72-hour window for a consolidated draft of re-answers and an annotated diff. Plan below:

Action items (internal):
- Day 1 (today): map the new question IDs to our prior responses and produce an annotated-diff CSV. (owner: karthik)
- Day 2: draft consolidated responses spreadsheet (owner: marissa)
- Day 3: internal review + redline; send draft to Elena for review by EOD. (owner: vanessa)

Notes / clarifications needed:
1) The packet references an updated key rotation cadence question (A.3.4.2) and expects evidence of HSM/KMS rotation logs. We have rotation logs but they live in an internal S3 path and require masked extracts for external consumption — confirm whether a redacted log excerpt is acceptable.
2) There are two new multi-tenancy isolation questions (M.1 & M.2) that map to our container network policies and tenant label enforcement; karthik will include pointers to policy docs and a short config export.

Attachments we'll provide in the draft: redwood_SIG_responses_draft_v1.xlsx, sig-annotated-diff.csv. Final evidence (e.g., masked logs) will be staged in a secure share and linked.

If ACME needs the 72-hour delivery as a hard SLA, please confirm; otherwise, we prefer to slot a final internal review window so we don't ship unvetted logs.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0134
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@cloudtrust.com>, David Lopez <david.lopez@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG packet (revision 2026-10) — annotated-diff and evidence plan

Vanessa / team / Elena,

Attached is the initial annotated diff and a short implementation note for the controls I flagged. Summary:
- A.3.4.2 (KMS rotation): we rotate keys every 90 days by policy. Evidence: masked rotation log excerpt (attached). File: evidence-kms-rotation-2026-09.log (I will redact key IDs).
- M.1 / M.2 (multi-tenant isolation): mapped to network-policy v2 and tenant-label enforcement in our runtime. I included the config export path and a short snippet in the diff.
- New scoring question set (S.12.*): minor wording changes only; existing answers still apply but I rephrased a few to match new IDs.

I've uploaded the diff CSV: sig-annotated-diff.csv, and started a draft of the responses sheet redwood_SIG_responses_draft_v1.xlsx. The draft includes an "answer status" column (unchanged / re-answer / need-evidence) to help triage.

For evidence staging, proposed approach:
- Create a pre-authenticated, time-limited share at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCT-SIG/overview and put redacted logs + config exports there.
- Provide a readme mapping each evidence file to the SIG question ID.

If the assessor side needs signed attestations for any control, loop in Legal — otherwise the redacted logs and config exports should be sufficient for initial review.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Reliability Engineering (redwood-infra)
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@cloudtrust.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: David Lopez <david.lopez@acme-retail.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-03 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG packet (revision 2026-10) — next steps

Thanks Vanessa / Karthik — that plan works for ACME. A couple quick follow-ups before we close: 

1) Redacted KMS rotation logs are acceptable for initial review, but ACME Security will request full audit logs under NDA if we move to final attestation. Please flag any entries that include customer-specific IDs.
2) For M.1/M.2, if you can include a short explanatory paragraph in the spreadsheet cell (2–3 lines) describing how tenant label enforcement prevents cross-tenant traffic, that will speed review.

If you hit any blocker on the 72-hour draft delivery, notify me so ACME Procurement can adjust their internal schedule — they prefer not to, but they can extend the draught window by 48 hours if needed.

I'll expect the draft spreadsheet and annotated diff by EOD 2026-11-03. Once we have that, I'll produce a redline summary and indicate any questions that need deeper evidence.

Regards,
Elena Ramos
Senior Assessor, CloudTrust Security
